papers.title: Dance teacher's note
lines: Sevillanas: four parts, four steps, four sets of flirtation. It looks easy and it is not.
Lesson one is the skirt. Lesson two is the wrist. Lesson three is not looking at your feet.

papers.title: Frontier worker's note
lines: Every day I cross the border to work in Gibraltar and every night I cross back to sleep in Spain.
I carry two passports in two pockets. I say hello in two languages. I am home in both.

papers.title: Tapas menu from a Spanish holiday
lines: Tortilla, croquetas, jamón, padron peppers, all delivered at once and all gone in minutes.
The waiter laughed at our order. He brought extra, free, because we looked hungry.

papers.title: Postcard from La Línea
lines: Hello from the edge of Spain. The Rock is just across the bay and looks like a sleeping lion.
I have been told it is a very fine Rock. I have not been told how to cross to see it.
